name: Cart Drawer
summary: Canonical Cart Line Item collection and optional compact target summary composed inside Drawer.

anatomy.name: lineItems
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Cart Line Item collection for a populated target cart.

anatomy.name: summary
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted compact description list for populated carts.

anatomy.name: summaryRow
anatomy.description: Term and target-formatted value association inside the compact summary.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One cart composition inside canonical Drawer.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Drawer bounds and Cart Line Item containers own responsive geometry.

states.name: populated
states.description: One or more canonical target-owned Cart Line Item records.

behavior.name: drawerComposition
behavior.description: Cart Drawer supplies commerce content to canonical Drawer and does not duplicate its open, placement, naming, focus, dismissal, or lifecycle API.

behavior.name: lineItemComposition
behavior.description: Populated target records consume canonical Cart Line Item, including its Price, Quantity Selector and optional Button dependencies, without parallel markup or behavior.

behavior.name: summarySemantics
behavior.description: Optional summary labels and complete target-formatted values use description-list associations and update from target cart truth.

behavior.name: targetOwnedCart
behavior.description: The target owns line identity, quantity constraints, mutations, formatted totals, empty/error/status content, post-removal focus, checkout and persistence.

behavior.name: emptyTargetContent
behavior.description: When lineItems is absent, the target supplies meaningful empty content and omits the compact summary; Cart Drawer does not choose the empty-state visual.

properties.name: lineItems
properties.unsetBehavior: Render target-authored empty content and omit the compact summary.
properties.description: Optional canonical Cart Line Item collection populated from target cart records.

properties.name: summary
properties.description: Optional target-formatted compact description-list rows, rendered only with populated line items.

accessibility: Compose canonical Drawer modal naming, focus containment, Escape dismissal, scroll partition, inertness, and logical focus restoration without duplicating that public API.
Use canonical Cart Line Item list and line semantics for every populated target record rather than a Drawer-specific line implementation.
Use one description list for compact summary label/value associations and omit it for empty content.
Announce confirmed mutation, error, item-count, and total results once through a target-owned status channel; do not make Price or the summary live independently.
After target-confirmed removal, place focus on a surviving logical line action or the Drawer title according to the surrounding target policy.

web.notes: The docs target composes canonical Drawer and Cart Line Item with a compact summary; production cart state remains target-owned.

shopify.notes: Liquid maps cart records into canonical Cart Line Item plus localized summary and checkout. Production Drawer lifecycle, mutation/section refresh, pending/error/status, and editor/store proof remain required.
